%@ name :: Railway Rescheduling under Multiple Disruptions
%@ desc :: A MILP model for railway rescheduling considering retiming, reordering, cancelling, and adding stops. The model aims to minimize delays and cancellations while respecting platform capacity and rolling stock circulation constraints.

%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations.

%@ param a_i shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Scheduled arrival time of train i at station s.
%@ param d_i_dep shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Scheduled departure time of train i from station s.
%@ param cap_s shape=S kind=scalar domain=integer :: Capacity of station s.
%@ param min_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Penalty weight for delays.
%@ param cancel_penalty shape=- kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Penalty weight for cancelling a train.
%@ var t_arr shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=arrival_time lo=- hi=- :: Actual arrival time of train i at station s.
%@ var t_dep shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=departure_time lo=- hi=- :: Actual departure time of train i from station s.
%@ var x_cancel shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=cancellation lo=0 hi=1 :: Binary variable: 1 if train i is cancelled.
%@ var x_stop shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=stop_decision lo=0 hi=1 :: Binary variable: 1 if train i stops at station s.
%@ var y_plat shape=T,S,P domain=binary role=primary drole=platform_assignment lo=0 hi=1 :: Binary variable: 1 if train i uses platform p at station s.
%@ var delay shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=delay lo=0 hi=- :: Delay of train i at station s.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_disruption_cost combination=sum :: Minimize the sum of delay penalties and cancellation penalties.
%@ con arrival_relation kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Arrival time must be at least scheduled arrival plus delay.
%@ con departure_relation kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Departure time must be at least scheduled departure plus delay.
%@ con travel_time_relation kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Travel time between stations must be respected.
%@ con stop_consistency kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: If a train is cancelled, it cannot arrive or depart.
%@ con platform_assignment_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: A train must be assigned to exactly one platform if it stops.
%@ con platform_capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Platform capacity constraints per station.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{min\_delay} \cdot \mathit{delay}_{i,s} + \sum_{i \in \mathcal{T}} \mathit{cancel\_penalty} \cdot \mathit{x\_cancel}_{i} \tag{total\_disruption\_cost} \\
  & t\_arr_{i,s} \ge a_{i,s} + \mathit{delay}_{i,s} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{arrival\_relation} \\

  & t\_arr_{i,s} \ge t\_dep_{i,s\_prev} + d_{i,s\_prev,s} - \mathit{M} \cdot \mathit{x\_cancel}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{travel\_time\_relation} \\

  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} y\_plat_{i,s,p} = x\_stop_{i,s} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{platform\_assignment\_limit} \\
